title: Business websites and contact pages
note: A website establishes business context. It does not automatically establish business pain or buying intent.
do_not_mix_rule: Website research runs as its own pass. It may deepen an existing lead from another source, but must not duplicate the business.
sources: Contact pages and published business email addresses
Publicly documented integrations and technology requirements
Public careers pages and project requests
access_rules: Respect website terms, access restrictions, privacy requirements and applicable laws.
Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs or technical restrictions.
Do not submit forms, create accounts or trigger transactions during research.
Record source URLs for material claims.
If a page cannot be accessed, mark it unverified rather than inferring its contents.
claim_restrictions: Do not claim to have audited a website's backend, database, CRM or analytics unless there is authorized evidence of those systems.
Do not label a website slow, insecure, broken, poorly converting or technically deficient without testing that supports the specific claim.

service_rule: Do not recommend a service simply because it is technically possible. Establish a connection between the business evidence and the proposed solution.

A.name: Explicit requirement
examples: The business requests a developer to integrate its website with a CRM
A public project brief asks for automated customer intake
The company states it wants to deploy a chatbot or automate a documented process
A business requests a website redesign or new landing page
A.caveat: Strong evidence of a stated requirement, but not necessarily a commitment to purchase from an external freelancer.

B.name: Observable workflow opportunity
examples: A website provides a contact form and publicly documents a multistep inquiry process
The business supports appointment booking and has an identifiable intake integration requirement
A company publicly documents several disconnected customer-contact channels
A business describes repetitive information collection or data processing
B.caveat: Record what is actually observable. A form, booking system or several contact channels alone does not prove the current process is inefficient.

C.name: Contextual business fit
examples: An e-commerce business sells products online
A real estate agency collects property inquiries
A digital agency offers marketing or website development services
C.caveat: Useful for identifying a relevant service, but not sufficient evidence of an unmet need. Continue researching or classify the opportunity as unverified.

tier_mapping.note: Signal C alone stays unverified and is not saved as a qualified lead.

research_workflow: Verify the business name and official domain.
Review its homepage and relevant service pages.
Inspect publicly accessible contact, FAQ, booking and support pages when relevant.
Identify specific, observable workflows or explicitly stated requirements.
Record the exact page URL supporting each material observation.
Look for a relevant project, service requirement or credible commercial trigger.
Match one proposed service to one relevant portfolio example.
Identify a legitimate public business contact channel.
Decide whether outreach is justified now or additional evidence is required.

evidence_classification.observed_fact: Directly visible or explicitly stated on a cited public page.
evidence_classification.opportunity_hypothesis: A possible way a service could help, derived from the observed fact.
evidence_classification.confirmed_requirement: A business requirement explicitly stated by an authorized business representative or in a verifiable project brief.
evidence_classification.confirmed_buying_intent: Evidence that the business is considering or willing to procure the relevant service.
rules: Never present an opportunity hypothesis as confirmed pain or buying intent.
Do not infer buying intent merely from the existence of a requirement.

portfolio_matching.rule: Select the closest relevant project. If none is relevant, state that no close portfolio match was found.

evidence_strength.question: Is there a specific, verifiable requirement or workflow signal?

service_fit.question: Does the evidence match an actual service the engineer can deliver?

business_verification.question: Is the business and its official domain verified?

commercial_suitability.question: Is a paid project or pilot plausible based on the available evidence?

contactability_personalization.question: Is there a suitable public business contact channel and a specific outreach reason?

scoring.gate: These thresholds prioritise research; they do not predict conversion. A generic website with no relevant workflow evidence must not receive a high evidence score merely because it belongs to a suitable industry.

missing_value_rule: Use unknown or null for unavailable information. Never fabricate website content, contact details, budgets, pain points or decision-maker identities.

outreach_requirements.write_only_when: There is a defensible reason to contact the business.
message_must: Reference a specific, genuine detail from the business website
Explain a relevant potential improvement without asserting an unverified problem
Offer one clearly scoped service or small pilot
Include a relevant portfolio example when useful
message_must_not: Use the same generic pitch for every business in a category
State the business is losing leads, responding slowly or wasting staff time without evidence
outreach_requirements.weak_evidence_rule: If the evidence is contextual rather than specific, recommend further research before outreach.

dedupe.merge_rule: Merge records for the same business where appropriate while retaining distinct source URLs and evidence.
dedupe.additional_evidence_rule: Additional website evidence may strengthen an existing record without creating a duplicate.

silence_rule: Do not treat a lack of response as confirmation that the business has no need.
operating_principle: Verify the business. Inspect the relevant pages. Record the evidence. Form a bounded opportunity hypothesis. Match the service. Then decide whether outreach is justified.
empty_result_rule: Never manufacture a pain point to increase lead counts.

quantity_policy.rule: No numeric limit. Return every qualified business and no unqualified ones.
